text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The final race of the Classics, the Kikuka Sho, turns out to be the grounds for a battle between three Mejiro Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro McQueen, who excels at long distances, is determined to win. It will be difficult to pull ahead victorious against her determination.
